## Installation

You can install the development version of praiseme from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("notKronk/praiseme")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

```{r example}
library(praiseme)
## basic example code
praise("John Doe")
praise("Me","?!")
```
